description: Change or keyframe existing paint strokes (Paint effect, Timeline panel): Start and End (write-on), colour, diameter, hardness, opacity, flow and the other brush settings, a clone stroke's Clone Position, Clone Time and Clone Time Shift, the stroke's Transform, and the effect's Paint on Transparent. Strokes themselves are drawn by hand with the Brush, Clone Stamp or Eraser tool

clonePosition.description: Clone strokes: Clone Position [x, y], where the stroke samples from

cloneTimeShift.description: Clone strokes: Clone Time Shift, seconds

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

effect.description: Which effect, by name or 1-based index in the Effect Controls panel; omit for every one of its kind on the layer

end.description: End, percent (animate it to write the stroke on)

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

paintOnTransparent.description: The Paint effect's Paint on Transparent switch

start.description: Start, percent of the stroke drawn from

strokes.description: Strokes by name (e.g. "Brush 1", "Clone 2") or 1-based index; omit for every stroke

time.description: Seconds: set keyframes at this time (animates the strokes). Default: static values, or keyframes at the current time on animated properties

name: set_paint_strokes
title: Set Paint Strokes
